Theorem
[Interior first derivative estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0267 1. ch14:14.13\group Local Curvature Estimates

If $\overline B_{g(0)}(p,r)\Subset \mathcal U$ and $|\operatorname {Rm}|\le K$ on $B_{g(0)}(p,r) imes [0, au ]$, then \[ | abla \operatorname {Rm}(y,t)|\le C(n)K \left(r^{-2}+t^{-1}+K ight)^{1/2} \] for $y\in B_{g(0)}(p,r/2)$ and $0<t\le au $.
Proof

\sketch Fix $(y,t)$ and put $A=r^{-2}+t^{-1}+K$. After the parabolic rescaling by $A$, the curvature is at most one, the available spatial radius is at least one, and the backward time interval has length at least a dimensional constant. The localized Bernstein quantity $(16+|\operatorname {Rm}|^2)| abla \operatorname {Rm}|^2$, multiplied by a distance barrier vanishing on the parabolic boundary, satisfies the same negative-quadratic inequality as in Theorem 3. The maximum principle bounds the rescaled gradient by $C(n)$. Scaling back multiplies the bound by $K\sqrt A$, proving the result.

□
